correctness.rationale: For an arbitrary F_q-linear algebra isomorphism, mixed products of different source basis vectors vanish. Independence of the nonzero target basis squares then forces the products of distinct entries of each isomorphism-matrix row to vanish. Invertibility makes the matrix monomial. The permutation satisfies sigma(i+1)=sigma(i)+1, leaving rotations. At rotation k the recurrence lambda_{i+1}=lambda_i^2 d_{i+k}/c_i closes exactly when lambda_0^N=Theta(c)/Theta(rot_k d), so necessity and sufficiency hold in every characteristic. In the quotient by N-th powers, Theta(rot_1 d)=Theta(d)^2 since their ratio differs by d_0^N. Every quotient class is realized (vary a single coefficient), and squaring is invertible and has m-th power the identity. The fixed set of squaring^k has gcd(g,2^k-1) elements, including g for k=0. Burnside counts the classes; separately each of h admissible rotations has exactly g scalar lifts, giving gh automorphisms. If g>1 the identity orbit cannot include any other class, proving the collapse criterion. Read the frozen verifier as consistency evidence; fresh exact checks with python3 /workspace/review_evidence/5_gf4_witness.py tested 180 invertible maps on each of the 81 ordered weight pairs and recovered two classes and automorphism-order histogram {3:6,6:3} on the nine tuples. The theorem is the symbolic recurrence, not an inference from those examples. It treats algebras given by one directed cycle over the base field, not all descent forms of the scalar-extended algebra or all perfect evolution algebras.

value.rationale: A single cycle is the basic nonzero permutation support. The arithmetic obstruction determines exactly when the familiar unit-weight normalization fails, enumerates the resulting nonisomorphic forms in every dimension, and tells when graph rotations lift to rational automorphisms. The explicit all-dimension answer replaces an unrestricted matrix orbit search; it is not simply the F_4 example or a low-dimensional recomputation.
